mentions.name: pwtray
mentions.description: This app provides Alfred/Spotlight-style quick access search for Bitwarden. Built in Rust using bwc-cli, it decrypts the vault into zeroized memory and offers near-instant search via a hotkey, with add-on features to copy card numbers and view notes.
